value.rationale: The model is the minimal coherent planar redundant-row test for complete random reshuffling, motivated directly by tight worst-permutation estimates in the cited 2024 RRK theory. It yields an exact finite-horizon transfer identity and complete quantitative classification of mean-square versus almost-sure exponential rates for every duplicate count and overlap, including a universal strict gap and divergent scale separation near orthogonality. The distinction guides interpretation of conservative rate bounds and typical-versus-expected convergence in randomized linear solvers, without claiming general systems or superior per-row complexity.
